# Eye Love Optical Boutique

> Independent optical boutique in Cazenovia, New York, run by New York State-licensed opticians. We sell handcrafted designer eyeglasses and sunglasses from independent eyewear houses, fill prescriptions with premium lenses and coatings, and offer one-on-one frame styling.

- Address: 65 Albany Street, Cazenovia, NY 13035
- Phone: (315) 825-1143
- Email: shawna@eyeloveboutique.com
- Hours: Tuesday through Friday, 10 am to 5 pm. Saturdays by appointment only. Walk-ins welcome during open hours.
- Owner: Shawna Clarke, New York State-licensed optician (LDO)
- Booking: https://squareup.com/appointments/book/pu60wjn6ahmgd9/LJMZQ2MZR4TSC/start
- Gift cards: https://squareup.com/gift/ML8W48JWJ7S1A/order

## What we do

- Fill eyeglass prescriptions. Customers can bring a prescription, or we contact their eye doctor's office for it.
- Premium prescription lenses from leading lens makers, with anti-reflective, Transitions and specialty coatings.
- Personal frame styling and fitting by licensed opticians.
- Free frame adjustments for life on every pair; warranties available.
- Most glasses are ready in about 5 to 7 business days.
- Frames for kids, plus reading glasses (readers).
- We do not perform eye exams. We recommend local optometrists.
- We do not bill insurance directly. Every purchase includes a detailed, itemized receipt for out-of-network reimbursement.

## Brands

Face à Face Paris, Etnia Barcelona, Bevel, Chroma, Pellicer, Lool, Dutz, American Optical, Maui Jim, and more.
